items.text: That seven year thing is a myth. Different cells in your body are replaced at wildly different intervals. Some within a few days, others lasting over a year, and some, like the neurons in the cerebral cortex, aren't replaced at all when they die. They're just gone.

Protein has a greater thermogenic value than the other macronutrients. It costs a little more energy to break down and digest than cabs and fats, but mostly it promotes greater satiety and in turn helps in calorie reduction. Losing weight (fat) is a bit easier on a high-protein diet for most people, so that's why its made into such a big deal in media and advertising.
